name: evaluate
description: Evaluate mathematical expressions: arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, statistics. Returns computed result. E.g., "2+2", "sin(pi/2)", "sqrt(16)", "mean([1,2,3])". Use when you need to calculate or simplify math.

name: convert_units
description: Convert between units: length, weight, temperature, volume, time, etc. Returns converted value. E.g., "5 m to ft", "100 kg to lbs", "32 degF to degC". Use for unit conversions.
